example.title: Dana Point Harbor outer breakwater
example.place: Dana Point Harbor, Dana Point, Orange County, CA

brief: The harbour's outer breakwater (built 1966-69 for the harbour that opened in 1971): a long rubble-mound mole of big grey quarry-stone armour running out from under the headland cliffs and bending along the seaward side of both marina basins, a flat crest of smaller stone with a white navigation light tower at the end, surf breaking along the outer face and calm water inside. Four photos (aerial and from the headland). Piles carried 10 m or more below the modelled bed (spec rule 4).

names.sign: SOLANA POINT HARBOR — BREAKWATER · NO CLIMBING
